text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, as Yaeno Muteki and I are training for the Takarazuka Kinen…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Bamboo?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All right! I set a new record for the training course!
choice_data_list: And I thought we were going all out…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh! Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Didja see? Didja see? I just set a new school record!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm the best racer ever at Tracen Academy! Isn't that awesome?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I saw. But why are you pushing yourself so hard just before the Takarazuka Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Haha! That's a good point! But I don't want to lose to some old record!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That's just like you. You're always going all out.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You're the same in actual races as well. But isn't that why you run out of energy before the final sprint?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Urgh! So you noticed that, huh…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I think it would benefit you to learn how and when to use your strength.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But I don't wanna finish a race and feel like I could've gone harder! I'd rather run till I drop!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You always seem so relaxed during races. Are you really giving it all you've got?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I get the feeling you and I actually aren't so different… I guess that's why I feel like you're always holding back.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah, but the Japanese Derby was a different story! You were totally on fire then!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ever since then, I can't help but feel like you've got power you're not using!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You think I was better… at the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Does it really look like I'm not giving it my all right now?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That can't be right. I have my obsession now, and it's burning so strongly…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Takarazuka Kinen has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: What a bummer that Oguri's not running today… Oh, Yaeno Muteki's here? She's pretty fast too!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Pretty fast? She's been doing well at every single race. I'm telling you she's the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Hold the phone! Is that Sakura Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan over there?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Dude, shut up! You're gonna bother them! But thank goodness… They both look like they're doing well. I wonder if they're gonna get back to racing soon.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Inariiiii! It's such an honor to race with you today!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh, Bamboo! Love that energy ya always have!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Just what I like to see! Make sure you bring that into the race with you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Count on it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, Yaeno! Where's your game face? Ya look like you're just gettin' ready to eat my dust!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Don't worry about me. I'm suppressing the flames of battle inside me until it's time to let it loose.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Don't see why ya gotta be so precious about it.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: But whatevz! Just stay outta my way!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Say what you want, but my blaze fierce and water still are perfectly balanced.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm ready!
